id: Passage size: Proof of Proposition 12.1, formal multiple
note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved; ZInQ.Syntax.leastFormalMultiple a definition: The parts give m0 <= N^6 from actual reduction orders, success of N^4*m0 (so M0 <= Ns^10 with the divisibility and coprimality guard), the bad-place reduction to (2,6), good reduction elsewhere and the odd coefficient extraction; they are stated for every N >= 1, not only Ns. The per-prime order bound comes from a trivial point count (order <= 2|k|+1, total <= p^6) in place of Hasse's bound; the odd estimate 2+8v_p(N) and the dyadic estimate are proved inside exists_formal_multiple.
